caseName: Orwitz v. Board of Dental Examiners
caseNameFull: Orwitz v. Board of Dental Examiners of California

opinions.text: The motion for a writ of certiorari to correct a diminution of the record is granted. Treating the paragraph which *707the appellant seeks to include in the record as duly certified, the petition for rehearing is denied. 313 U. S. 546.
